section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the assessment instruments used in the current study, including the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) with 13 items and Cronbach's alpha of .92, the Multidimensional Body Self-Relations Questionnaire Appearance Evaluation Subscale (MBSRQ-AE), the Multigroup Ethnic Identity Measure (MEIM), the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSES), the Sociocultural Attitudes Toward Appearance Scale–3 Internalization-General Subscale (SATAQ-3), the Eating Attitudes Test-26 Dieting Subscale (EAT-26), the Eating Disorders Self-Examination-Questionnaire (EDE-Q), the Physical Appearance–Related Testing Scale Weight/Size Teasing Subscale (PARTS), and a Demographics Questionnaire. The section provides detailed descriptions of each instrument's items, response scales, validity evidence, and internal consistency coefficients for the current sample.
section_summary.evidence_source: Entire Measures section from 'Body Appreciation Scale' through 'Demographics Questionnaire'.
